title: Connector command response
description: Response of POST /api/connectors/{connectorId}/request and of the JSON-RPC "connector.request" result. Error codes are the SAME typed set FormLogic's ConnectorError already parses (form-builder/ui/src/client-runtime/connectors/connectorTypes.ts), so browser fallback semantics apply unchanged: only ipc_unavailable and connector_missing are fallbackable. Canonical copy: formlogic-app/docs/contracts/.

code.description: auth_required is desktop-transport-only (missing/expired pairing token); it must be handled by the desktop client before the connector layer and never surfaces as a ConnectorError.
